thread:
sara: quick sync — we need to lock the webinar narrative and the backstage comms plan. want something that walks customers from problem -> cost/latency tradeoffs -> 2 short demos -> Q. not a 30-slide benchmark dump.

mike: +1. proposed runtime angle: 'practical inference economics' but short. 25m content, 15m live Q + polls.

anya: schedule check — i can do demo code on Sep 28 10am PT or Sep 30 2pm PT. prefer the earlier slot.

rafa: audience ask — are we expecting platform engineers or product managers? that'll change how deep we go on batching/kv-cache.

priya: for slides i can draft a visual flow: problem -> microbenchmark story -> demo 1 (latency-focused) -> demo 2 (cost-focused) -> takeaways + ops checklist. need speaker bios by EOD Thu.

sara: target audience = platform + infra-adjacent PMs. keep one callout slide with config recommendations (batching, quantization) and a one-liner for enterprise constraints.

mike: Demo split idea — 6m demo (low-latency) + 6m demo (cost-optimized) + 4m explainers. live fallback: play recorded clip if live model hiccup.

priya: ok. who owns the recorded clip?

anya: i'll record the fallback short video. also will create a minimal script for the live demo so we can reliably repro in rehearsal.

rafa: inbound routing note — we want a CTA that routes enterprise trial interest to AE queue and self-serve leads to the docs + trial link. We'll add hidden UTMs to the registration link.

sara: good — add a slide after Q showing routing: "Enterprise -> AE demo request, Self-serve -> Get started + cheatsheet".

mike: tech rehearsal plan — two dry runs: 72h before (end-to-end, deck + demos) and 24h before (lights + slide run). also a short 15m backstage comms sync 30m before show.

priya: noted. ops needs: one person to advance slides, one to monitor chat, one to ping speakers, one to trigger fallback. who volunteers?

tim: i'll be slide/tech lead. i'll provision staging cluster and a dedicated fallback model endpoint. deploybot: scheduled staging cluster snapshot for 2026-09-26T09:00:00Z.

deploybot: staging snapshot created: snapshot-20260926-0900 (id: snap-9a7f).

anya: i'll do chat monitoring during show and trigger fallback if latency > 1.5s p99. will post an inline message when switching to recorded clip.

rafa: i'll own the CTA routing and follow-up email content. can someone draft the follow-up within 24h?

priya: i'll draft follow-up and the final slide deck; will need final speaker bios + headshots by Thu EOD.

sara: action items:
- anya: prepare two short demo scripts + record fallback clip (due 2026-09-24)
- priya: initial deck draft + follow-up template (due 2026-09-25)
- tim: staging + fallback endpoint provisioning (done) + join rehearsals
- rafa: registration CTAs + routing + UTMs (due 2026-09-25)
- mike: final narrative + rehearsal coordinator (due 2026-09-24)

```
00:00 - Intro & problem framing (sara)
05:00 - Microbenchmark narrative (mike)
10:00 - Demo 1: latency path (anya)
16:00 - Demo 2: cost path (anya)
22:00 - Recommendations & config cheatsheet (priya/mike)
27:00 - Live Q + poll (all)
40:00 - Wrap + CTA + post-webinar routing (rafa)
```

mike: re: polls — let's do one poll at start (what's your primary role?) and one before Q (which tradeoff matters most?). keeps engagement.

priya: will prepare 2 slide variations: deep-ops and non-ops friendly.

rafa: registration copy draft here: https://docs.google.com/example-reg-copy (please add UTMs).
